name: screen-cloak
description: Hides emails, phone numbers, money, account numbers and names you list from what is drawn on screen, so you can share your screen. Claude still sees everything.

startOn.title: Start with Cloak on
startOn.description: Turn Cloak on at the start of every session.

alwaysHide.title: Names to always hide
alwaysHide.description: Names and terms to hide in every session, separated by commas. Saved in your settings file as plain text. Names added with /cloak add stay in this session only.

revealSeconds.title: Reveal lasts (seconds)
revealSeconds.description: How long a reveal stays before the details are hidden again.

hoverReveal.title: Reveal on hover
hoverReveal.description: Let the pointer reveal a hidden detail in the Cloak panes and assistant messages. Always off while recording mode is on.

hideBandWhenOff.title: Hide the band when Cloak is off
hideBandWhenOff.description: Show the Cloak band above the prompt only while Cloak is on. Use /cloak on to turn it back on.
